name: Mailjet
tagline: European email API for transactional and marketing mail
description: Mailjet provides REST APIs for sending transactional and marketing email, managing contacts, lists, and templates, and retrieving statistics and events. Email API v3/v3.1 uses HTTPS Basic Auth with an API key and secret; SMS API v4 uses Bearer-token authentication. Its email infrastructure is GDPR-compliant and EU-hosted.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and secret key as password; keys from account settings. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 6,000 emails per month, maximum 200 emails per day, and up to 1,000 contacts.

rate_limits: API calls are limited per API key per second; universal numeric thresholds are not published. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429. Transactional APIs have higher limits than other Email and SMS APIs.
use_cases: send a transactional email with HTML and text body
send a campaign email using a stored template
list or create contacts and contact lists
retrieve delivery open and bounce statistics
manage sender domains and validate sender addresses
